exact_variables: passer EPA per dropback, weekly EWMA
families.E_seasons: 1999+ via PBP passer_player_name+epa; local pbp_2018.parquet has 372 cols incl. passer fields
families.I_leakage: Low if weekly-batched on prior games only; must key on pre-week starter, not post-hoc passer
families.J_different: Partially — team pass EPA already embeds QB play
families.K_duplicates: High overlap with off_pass_epa; external ablations (howlscastle97, colemason6524, wadefuller) + our v2 all found no gain vs close

families.J_different: Partially — accuracy component partly orthogonal to EPA
families.K_duplicates: Correlates with pass EPA; rbsdm uses 0.5*z(EPA/db)+0.5*z(CPOE) composite; ablation evidence negative vs close
families.verdict: TIER 3 — plausible but external evidence says market prices it

families.J_different: Marginal — recency is a weighting choice on already-covered signal; Exp 001 found recency weighting degraded
families.K_duplicates: Yes — same info as QB EPA with different weights

families.J_different: Yes — verticality is not in V1
families.K_duplicates: Partial — deep passing shows up in pass EPA; aDOT isolates scheme/verticality
families.verdict: TIER 2 — folds naturally into explosiveness family; test as part of it, not standalone

exact_variables: share of team's last 16 starts by current starter (qb_fam)
starter EPA vs team EPA gap
families.B_partial: Partial — 11_injury_adjust voids picks on unexpected QB Out/Doubtful, but does not measure continuity/familiarity
families.I_leakage: Low — starter must be the pre-game listed/expected starter, never the post-hoc passer
families.J_different: Yes — answers 'was this team EPA generated by the guy playing Sunday?', which team EPA cannot
families.verdict: TIER 2 — small, clean, genuinely different; howlscastle97 kept it as foundation for injury work; pickledger calls QB-change the biggest single-player effect

families.I_leakage: Low — weekly team aggregates, batch pre-week
families.J_different: Yes — trench quality channel absent from V1
families.K_duplicates: Partial — pressure shows up in pass EPA outcomes; the *rate* isolates process from result
families.verdict: TIER 1 — wadefuller found pressure rate rank 41/real signal but substitution vs starter_pass_epa; V1 has no QB-EPA to displace, so net-addition case is cleaner here

families.E_seasons: 2016+ BUT 2023+ released post-postseason only (FTN-sourced); pre-2023 NGS
families.F_pregame: Historical yes; live NO for current season
families.H_timestampable: No for 2026 timing study — data arrives after season
families.I_leakage: Medium — post-season release means any 2023+ walk-forward use must prove the release date precedes the prediction date
families.verdict: TIER 2 — timing limitation kills production use; historical-only

exact_variables: OL snaps continuity: share of snaps by week-1 starting five
games started by current OL combo
families.verdict: TIER 2 — feasible; evidence base thinner than pressure

families.family: Explosive play rates + EPA distribution shape
families.B_partial: Partial — success rate captures consistency, not tails
families.E_seasons: 1999+ computable from local PBP (yards_gained, air_yards, epa all present)
families.I_leakage: Low — weekly aggregates of prior games
families.J_different: Yes — V1 sees only the mean (EPA) and threshold (success rate); the shape of the distribution is new
families.verdict: TIER 1 — used by multiple public models (pickledger, gesmith); genuinely absent from V1; computable today

families.family: PROE / pass rate over expected + early-down behavior + pace
exact_variables: pass_oe (pass rate over expected; xpass in local PBP)
families.E_seasons: xpass/pass_oe in nflfastR 4.0+ PBP (verified in local pbp_2018.parquet); 1999+ for rates
families.I_leakage: Low — weekly aggregates; xpass model is precomputed in PBP (no future info)
families.J_different: Yes — V1 knows efficiency, nothing about play-calling tendencies
families.verdict: TIER 1 — the most structurally absent dimension in V1; rbsdm tracks pass_oe_off as a core column

families.family: Unit-vs-unit interactions (pass O x pass D, rush O x rush D, pressure x pressure, explosive x explosive, QB x opposing pressure)
exact_variables: interaction terms of the above differentials
families.B_partial: Partial — GBM sees differentials jointly and can learn interactions
families.J_different: No — representation of existing info, not new information (cf. Exp 002 opp-adjusted EPA null)
families.K_duplicates: Yes — GBM already models joint structure
families.verdict: TIER 3 — representation, not information; Exp 002's null is directly on point

families.E_seasons: 1999+ PBP (punt/kick fields verified in local data)
families.verdict: TIER 2 — public derivation methods exist (Wharton paper); BUT dgrifka's rigorous study found ST partly unobservable (punt bounce: one spot per punt mixes flight+roll) and kickoff rule breaks in 2023/2024/2025 make cross-season pooling invalid; small share of margin variance

families.family: Fumble recovery luck / INT rate / turnover over-expectation
exact_variables: INT rate vs expected from pressure/CPOE
families.J_different: Yes — luck decomposition is not in V1
families.K_duplicates: Partial — turnovers are already inside EPA
families.verdict: TIER 3 — dgrifka (2,761 games, split-half): fumble recovery has zero team skill AND stripping luck did not improve out-of-sample prediction for any component. The actionable version is a modeling discipline (don't overreact to recovery luck), not a feature

families.family: Starting field position, points/drive, drive success rate
exact_variables: avg drive start yard line differential
families.E_seasons: 1999+ (drive_start_yard_line, fixed_drive, series_success verified in local PBP)
families.J_different: Partially — 'hidden yardage' channel distinct from per-play efficiency
families.K_duplicates: Partial — field position largely follows from the same efficiency
families.verdict: TIER 2 — feasible and clean; likely partially redundant with EPA

families.B_partial: Partial — rest_diff captures short-week/bye; div_game captures some travel structure
families.verdict: TIER 3 — wadefuller tested travel+timezone: 0 of 4 metrics improved, reverted; hit the 'saturation wall'

families.family: Roof / surface / altitude / primetime / neutral site
families.J_different: Marginal — mostly totals-relevant (wind already tested null on spreads)
families.verdict: TIER 3 for spreads — small effects, mostly priced; wind precedent (v2) was null

families.family: Snap share / usage / depth-chart rank / roster continuity
families.E_seasons: snap counts 2012+ weekly (verified 2026 in-season); rosters weekly
families.I_leakage: Low — prior-week snaps only; depth charts must be pre-game editions
families.K_duplicates: Partial — continuity mostly matters via the players' EPA already captured
families.verdict: TIER 2 — feasible; thinner evidence base; overlaps Exp 005 availability work

families.family: NGS weekly player aggregates (time to throw, separation, etc.)
families.H_timestampable: Partial — weekly aggregates update in-season; release timing vs prediction time must be verified
families.I_leakage: Medium — verify weekly release precedes the prediction
families.J_different: Partially — team-aggregated NGS ≈ air yards/CPOE already available in PBP
families.verdict: TIER 2 — marginal uniqueness at team level; player-level NGS is a props tool, not a margin tool

families.family: Blitz rate, play action, motion, contested targets, drops
exact_variables: is_motion / is_play_action / n_blitzers / is_contested_ball / is_drop team-week rates
families.E_seasons: 2022+ ONLY (verified); weekly in-season updates (2026 file live)
families.I_leakage: Low if date_pulled < prediction and only prior weeks aggregated
families.J_different: Yes — scheme/tendency info absent from V1
families.verdict: TIER 2 — cannot train on 2018-2020 window (no coverage); breaks current validation discipline; usable only with a redesigned train/validation split
